query:
SELECT
            g.id AS "id!",
            g.changeset_id AS "changeset_id: ChangesetRowId",
            c.state,
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM assertions a
                WHERE a.group_id = g.id AND a.retracted_at IS NULL
            ) AS "in_effect!: bool"
        FROM assertion_groups g
        JOIN changesets c
            ON c.id = g.changeset_id
        WHERE g.uuid = ?
